description: 繁體中文：Nivqo v1.33.0 同版覆蓋更新，內建 HushFacebook 0.7.1-nivqo.1 與 HushMessenger 0.14.0-nivqo.1 正式核心。HushFacebook 只同步上游正式 v0.7.1，共 60 個 patch，支援 Facebook 581.0.0.45.58 / versionCode 475215365，保留 580 與 577 支援；核心繁中表 572 筆，Manager patch metadata 60 / 60，並保留 Nivqo 介面語言選擇與 Facebook / Messenger 雙向路由。原版 Morphe Manager 的 Nivqo Patches 整合來源更新為 0.3.0，共 92 個 patch（Facebook 60 + Messenger 32）。App 顯示版本仍為 1.33.0，可由舊 v1.33.0 直接覆蓋更新。 English: Same-version Nivqo v1.33.0 replacement with bundled HushFacebook 0.7.1-nivqo.1 and HushMessenger 0.14.0-nivqo.1 formal cores. HushFacebook syncs only the formal upstream v0.7.1 release, has 60 patches, adds Facebook 581.0.0.45.58 / versionCode 475215365 while retaining 580 and 577 support, carries 572 Traditional Chinese core strings and 60 / 60 localized Manager patch metadata, and preserves the Nivqo interface-language selector and two-way Facebook / Messenger routing. The original Morphe Manager combined Nivqo Patches source is updated to 0.3.0 with 92 patches total (Facebook 60 + Messenger 32). The installed version name remains 1.33.0 and older v1.33.0 builds can update in place.
